item.content:encoded:
This one is fantastic.

Really well written - the way the testing method is explained and the unknown GoI is handled (by reporting to federal organizations while keeping tabs on it) is all great and I'd love to see more of this in non-EXes SCP as well.

As for the SCP itself: really cool take on it. As an outsider reader, it was kinda clear from the start where this was going; but it still made perfect sense that an organization so used to deal with supernatural stuff could stumble a bit and take a while to figure that mundane hallucinogens aren't some supernatural hazard. The way they tested for it was wodnerful as well.

item.content:encoded: "…it is not believed that SCP-067-EX’s containment procedures were ever up to Foundation standards." This combined with the incursions during Foundation containment definitely lead me to believe it's an internal breach. Why someone within the foundation would want to make a leaky nuclear reactor in a rundown inn is beyond me, but I'd love to see a related story!

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I'm *very* interested in a forensic investigation into Cause of Death for those excavated bodies.

If they died from crushing injuries, we may have a secret underground reactor-making lab that caved in on their heads. In that case, further investigation on the GOI may be possible by archaeological-style excavation.

If they did *not* die from crushing injuries, then the possibility of a mass grave "dump it and forget this mistake, shove the ore in there too" from the GOI becomes more likely.

item.content:encoded:
Fantastically well done. The logical progression from "We're pretty sure this is an SCP" to "Nope, just poor documentation and some hallucinogens" worked perfectly for me. The fact that, having read the ending, I can go back to the beginning, reread the whole thing and see a consistent set of symptoms that are logically connected to the root cause really brings it home for me.

The underlying hook of "Maybe it's not quite -EX just yet" works even better for me. +1 only because there's no +10 button
